text:
Samir Desai: hey team, first day here! running into two quick access blocks: (1) GCP: I can't see the billing account to link project 'redwood-playground' (console shows "You need permission to view billing accounts"). (2) AWS: after SSO I still show my user session and not the assumed role, so I can't push ECR images (AccessDenied). who is best to ping for each?
Hannah Lee: welcome Samir! for AWS that's usually SSO provisioning. what do you see when you run `aws sts get-caller-identity`?
Samir Desai: returns arn:aws:iam::555444333222:user/samir.dev, not an assumed-role.
Hannah Lee: sign out and re-launch from https://sso.redwood.com and pick the "Redwood-Developer" app, or run `aws sso login --profile redwood`. if that doesn't flip to assumed-role ping me and I'll re-run provisioning.
Infra Bot: Tip: SSO sometimes takes a minute after assignment. If you just got access, wait ~60s and re-login.
Samir Desai: re-did SSO, now `aws sts get-caller-identity` shows arn:aws:sts::555444333222:assumed-role/Redwood-Developer/Samir. testing ECR push now.
Samir Desai: push succeeded! thanks Hannah :tada:
Priyanka Rao: for GCP billing: Finance owns billing accounts. Please open an access ticket at https://access.redwood.com > New Request > Cloud Billing and include project id, billing account id if you have it (format BA-####) and your manager for approval. If you post the ticket id here I can expedite approval on the finance side.
Samir Desai: filed INC-11011 (linked project redwood-playground, BA unknown). tagged my manager.
Priyanka Rao: got INC-11011, approving now. FYI future hires: include BA id and desired billing export destination (BigQuery dataset) if you plan exports. speeds things up.
onboarding-bot: Friendly reminder: complete the cloud onboarding checklist to avoid delays: https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist
Samir Desai: billing link approved and visible now. everything unblocked. really appreciate the help!
